telemetry.counts: Actual successful dash execution, unique observed guard window, counter and shield-break triggers; no input-request or damage inference.
telemetry.amounts: Actual capped counter recovery, shield absorption and natural recovery; actual enemy HP damage attributed within synchronous counter/shield-break scopes.
telemetry.puppets: Actual condition-time denominators and effective time; actual spawned arrows only, extra bolts are a subset. No projectile metadata or claimed extra damage.
telemetry.coverage: New-run start clock is recorded, including nonzero legacy chapter presets. Missing old field begins a partial observation at restore time. Endless loops continue one accumulator.
telemetry.persistence: Detached snapshots/summaries follow existing save/restore/history/observation boundaries; no new save cadence, root key, receipt or leaderboard field.
telemetry.invalid: Malformed checkpoint telemetry uses existing explicit recovery/error/original-preservation flow. Missing or invalid old summaries display unknown instead of zero.
telemetry.legacyTimer: Deduplication marker follows previously accepted timer bounds. Counters are independent of distinct-window count; old accepted rule1/2 state and rule3 rejection remain unchanged.
telemetry.clock: Observed actual battle-clock delta for total and puppet durations; original dt still drives movement/cooldown/physics. Long valid clocks do not accumulate a false span overflow.

priorityBatch8.scope: Post-publication local T14 chapter resource, damage and survival observations; includes T13/R23-05. Existing v1.3 tag and published evidence are unchanged.

telemetry.damage: Observed opening cumulative damage baseline and current/end difference for eight sources. Existing per-rule contribution semantics, including legacy overkill, are preserved; no added synergy damage.
telemetry.reserve: Actual successful cast costs; distinct actual rest, chapter-entry and configuration gains, known rest capacity clipping and cap losses.
telemetry.otherResources: Observed opening/end balances for gold, rerolls and consumables including bonus medicine; no fabricated gross income or spending.
telemetry.survival: Minimum combat HP before revival with its then-current cap, actual player hits, HP loss, shield absorption, revivals and successful bag uses. Noncombat sacrifices and objective hits are not player hit events.
telemetry.nodes: At most four node/wave records per chapter, actual battle-clock increments, explicit unfinished/partial flags. Not formal chapterSplits or ranking data.
telemetry.combos: Each combo effect at most once: actual new formation after a trait choice, chapter/loop/node or wave/level/time/trait ID. Existing initial/restored combos have no invented timestamp.
telemetry.boundaries: Chapter-end rest remains in the outgoing chapter; next chapter opening uses pre-refill handoff balances. Incoming chapter receives its actual refill.
telemetry.persistence: Pure detached snapshots and summaries, restore collection disabled during the original reconstruction, then retained observations or a fresh partial origin. Successful candidate commit adopts independent observations; failed/quote candidates do not affect the live run.
telemetry.oldAndInvalid: Missing checkpoints start at actual restored state; missing/bad history shows unknown. Malformed checkpoint observation fields are refused through the existing original-preserving recovery flow.

priorityBatch8.fixtureMaintenance: Old synthetic chapter/clock/loop jumps start explicit observation baselines, or declare missing observations for legacy fixtures. The frozen touch comparison excludes only new chapterStats; other saved state remains exact. All 211 prior assertions in six browser fixture files retain their original source.
priorityBatch8.method: Declared engine/state/checkpoint and display fixtures, same-input frozen-source parity, actual browser input and offline package launches. Not new natural-speed player completions or physical-device validation.

retainedDetails.T17/T12/T29: No invented pair/fire-line attribution, uncollected damage breakdown or combat keyboard targeting.

compatibilityFix.finding: An old valid hp=100.0000005/maxHp=100 snapshot restored successfully but the new observed minimum was rejected at its next immediate checkpoint.
compatibilityFix.fix: Only this observed relationship follows original player maxHp+1e-6 tolerance. Actual HP, original snapshot limit and all other statistical tolerances are unchanged.

pauseOverlapFix.finding: At390x844 the pause point overlaps the close button of the taller review dialog; the second pointer press could resume combat. An exiting entry overlay could swallow the first test press and mask the failure.
pauseOverlapFix.fix: Only native pointer close-press on the pause dialog uses the existing same-point48px/450ms duplicate-gesture guard. Other dialogs, keyboard close and Escape are unchanged.
pauseOverlapFix.test: Wait for entry overlay detachment and trial-actionability before two real clicks/taps150ms apart; keep the original paused-state assertion and also verify normal later close and keyboard close.

ciResumeRepair.oldCICauseLimit: Original run lacks pre/post raw and initialization traces; ordinary local reload did not reproduce session flag loss. Do not label the full original sequence proved or a harmless flake.
confirmedFixtureDefects: Clearing a live scene can discard allocated XP drops without settling the ledger; validator correctly rejects it and preserves earlier disk checkpoint.
A reload-time init script can reseed an empty profile when its test session flag is absent; controlled flag removal reproduces the empty-home symptom and overwrites a valid checkpoint.
fix: Construct a quiet, current-rule first-node snapshot in Node synchronously before native frames; validate using normalizeSave and restoreRun.
Seed the isolated browser once from the driver, with no reload initialization writer or session flag dependency.
Assert actual successful persistence, run identity, revision and chapter observations before reload. Clear test sessionStorage and reopen a page, verifying exact stored bytes and saved statistics.
Capture isolated local/session raw, active/saved snapshots, save status and page text on failure.
